newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. official says no evidence yet of involvement by any country in Riyadh or Dhahran bombings.
- Gulf Arab states urge the European Investment Bank to increase its role in the region. France suggests launching a fund to finance power projects in Arab countries.
- Jordanian and Palestinian investors launch a $100 million investment company to set up projects in Jerusalem.
- Yemen executes a man for killing six people.
- Kuwaiti fund and Citibank in Malaysia provide a $100 million financing facility to Malaysian Airlines to buy fuel and spare parts.
- Around $3.2 billion worth of shares were traded on the Egyptian stock market in 1996. Share trading in January and February this year were worth $1.4 billion.
